verdict.rationale: Salesforce markets AI agents that run 24/7 and handle repetitive tasks autonomously, alongside built-in Sales Flows, lead routing, and automatic email/event syncing. Agents can be wired to Flows and Apex, and created and activated from the CLI. A community user says setting up a timed email automation took minutes, which corroborates background automation. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of triggers, scheduling and background-run behavior beyond marketing lines, and independent hands-on evidence that Agentforce agents actually run autonomously.
